survivors.rationale: begin_field_composition is private and is called only after update_composition has rejected the no-owner empty-preedit case. A newly created state therefore reaches the nonempty branch, which overwrites preview_visible with true before publishing it. Failure publishes no candidate. Later empty preedit assigns false explicitly. Changing this initial flag cannot affect any public field snapshot.

The saved original document and measurement were admitted with exact anchor/head cursor stops before composition began. Both are immutable snapshots under immutable font style. with_bounds validates the same saved pair before a resize. This boolean controls only rechecking those original cursor endpoints; all other geometry checks still run. Public operations cannot create an invalid saved selection, so disabling this redundant endpoint check on blur is equivalent for reachable public states.
